newsitem.title: GREECE: CRIMINAL ACTIVITY IN GREECE IS ON THE RISE - ANA.
newsitem.headline: CRIMINAL ACTIVITY IN GREECE IS ON THE RISE - ANA.

text.p: Greek public order ministry figures showed an increase in narcotics-related criminal activity in 1996, the state Athens News Agency (ANA) said.
Attica was the area which experienced the highest rise in criminal activities, ANA said.
The number of foreigners' arrests also increased significantly but petty theft cases diminished, it said.
"Additional policing measures to combat these crimes will be taken," Public Order Minister George Romeos was quoted as saying. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
